content:
Removes the specified scan and all vulnerabilities it detected. This request creates an asynchronous
deletion job.
Requires the Scan Operator [24] user role or the WAS.SCAN_WAS.MANAGE  custom role privilege.
Additionally, requires the Can Edit [64] scan permission. See Roles and Permissions.
AUTHORIZATIONS:
cloud
PATH PARAMETERS
string <uuid>
The UUID of the scan for which you want to delete.
